custom-image.looks: One image with an optional link and caption, at a chosen width and alignment.
custom-image.use: A standalone image, map, chart or infographic.
custom-image.avoid: A photo that goes with a paragraph: use Text Image or Split Card, which set them side by side.

fields.image: The image. Offer options with find_images unless the source gives a DAM path.
fields.imageAlt: What the image shows; for a chart, its main finding.
fields.captionText: Optional caption under the image, e.g. a source or credit.
fields.imageWidth: Share of the content column: width-25 to width-100, or empty for the image's own size. width-50 or width-66 suits a chart.
fields.imagePosition: align-left, align-center or align-right when the image is narrower than the column.
